Hero.title: Confidence begins with your skin.
Hero.subtitle: Experience the best of beauty treatments. Personalized aesthetic care designed to help you look and feel your best.

Sections.title: Experience the Best of Beauty Treatments
Sections.subtitle: Personalized aesthetic care designed to help you look and feel your best.
Sections.philosophyBody1: At Maryam Beauty Clinic, no two treatment plans look alike. We begin by listening — to your goals, your concerns and the way you want to feel in your own skin.
Sections.philosophyBody2: From there, our specialists design a considered, results-focused approach using modern aesthetic technology and genuine, personal care.
Sections.treatmentsTitle: A focused menu of aesthetic treatments
Sections.treatmentsSubtitle: Each tailored to your skin and your goals.
Sections.skinTitle: Healthy skin starts with the right treatment.
Sections.skinBody: Our skin treatments are built on a careful assessment of your complexion, so every session works toward calm, clear and genuinely healthy skin.
Sections.resultsBody: Browse our gallery of treatments performed at the clinic.
Sections.offersBody: Get exciting discounts on our services.
Sections.clinicTitle: Discover the Maryam Beauty Clinic experience.
Sections.clinicBody: A calm, considered space where advanced aesthetic treatments meet genuine, personal care. Every visit is designed to feel unhurried, private and entirely your own.
Sections.ctaBody: Book your consultation and let's create a treatment plan designed for you.
Sections.galleryIntro: There may be no better way to communicate what we do than through images. As you browse our site, take a few moments to let your eyes linger here, and see if you can get a feel for our signature touch.
